rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a literal forest or wooded area.

example.english: There are lots of monkeys in this forest.
example.traditional: 呢片森林入面有好多猴子。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin3 sam1 lam4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 hau4 zi2

rows.note: Use this for a figurative forest-like mass or large amount, such as a large amount of criticism.

example.english: There was a forest of criticism online, and it was suffocating.
example.traditional: 網上有一大堆批評，真係令人透唔到氣。
example.jyutping: mong5 soeng6 jau5 jat1 daai6 deoi1 pai1 ping4 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 tau3 m4 dou2 hei3
